parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=12 (0.8448) as it regressed from my DEPTH=10 best (0.8366). It seems the 5-minute budget is being spread too thin, leading to insufficient convergence for the higher capacity. Reverting to DEPTH=10. Next: testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if it stacks with DEPTH=10.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=10 after DEPTH=12 failed to converge well in 5 mins, and testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to improve regularization.
